items.content:
Two years of a scale on the counter and last month I just stopped.

It's not that precision doesn't matter. It's that I'd learned it — the
scoop is calibrated now, in my hand. Measuring was how I got here and
carrying it forever would be a different kind of not-trusting-myself.

summary: Retiring the scale after the scoop became calibrated by hand
title: I stopped weighing
